research_question: Can a 30-minute crypto move be separated before entry into idiosyncratic liquidation exhaustion versus residual price discovery by first removing the four-market common factor and then observing open-interest and a distinct 15-minute transition?

ideas_reused: medium-frequency return reversal after transitory price pressure
order-flow impact can decay when it is uninformed inventory transfer
open-interest destruction distinguishes liquidation from new directional risk
cross-sectional residuals separate common crypto beta from asset-specific repricing
external_mechanism.adaptation: A prior-only rolling beta removes the four-market median factor from every five-minute return. Thirty-minute residual shocks are routed by independent OI change and a subsequent 15-minute residual/flow transition.
not_used: raw return z-score without factor removal
same event bar as both state and confirmation

data.price_source: Binance Vision USD-M monthly five-minute futures klines
data.metrics_visibility: native five-minute create_time; state uses event timestamp or earlier; confirmation uses only the following three completed bars and entry follows their close

evaluation.same_event_arbitration: largest absolute residual z times OI-state magnitude times confirmation quality, then symbol
evaluation.overlap_policy: no selected episode while the fixed two-hour route horizon is active

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per evaluation calendar day after four-asset global arbitration

decision_contract.advance: Only a fixed route positive in development, year-long stability and July confirmation while passing integrated gates advances to NautilusTrader.
decision_contract.reject: Do not tune residual, OI, confirmation or horizon thresholds after observing these declared results. Preserve only a cross-split-positive route and move to another independent family.
